_comment: Turn turncard off with "enabled": false. Change "rulepack" to point at a different set of rules under rulepacks/.
_banned_note: A rulepack may ship <rulepack>.banned.json with words to flag and no replacement. The STE rulepack ships none, because ASD forbids redistribution of its dictionary. Build your own with tools/extract_ste_words.py, then set this to true.
